title: An accepted photo automatically creates one non-trainable raw dataset candidate

given.plant: active and authorized for a granted Engineer with can_operate=true
given.photo: a valid upload accepted by the FT-005 Photo Intake flow

when.command: accept_photo commits inside its unit of work
when.seam: the Dataset Governance creation seam runs in the same transaction

then.candidate: exactly one candidate row exists with candidate_status=candidate, candidate_origin=raw, quality_tier=standard, split=null, confirmation_source=null, can_train_on=false, and one typed photo evidence ref
then.idempotency: repeating the same accepted-photo operation creates no second candidate
then.authority: the Photo Intake catalog can_train_on=false assertion is unchanged and no timeline/UI/manifest/agent path granted trainability
